assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production fantasy game interface corner fitting, square image, front-facing orthographic. The whole background is perfectly flat pure green #00FF00 with no shading, no gradient and no cast shadows (it will be keyed out to transparency). An L-shaped TOP LEFT corner of polished midnight-indigo stone edged with aged brass, its two rails running along the TOP and LEFT edges only. The joint is held by an angular aged brass clasp from a wizard's observatory: a brass ring enclosing an engraved eight-pointed compass star, one small round amethyst cabochon set at the outermost corner, and two faceted violet amethyst crystal shards gripped by the brass, one lying along each rail and pointing away from the corner. Fine astronomical filigree and a few tiny engraved stars and crescent moons on the rails near the joint, as abstract marks and not readable text. Rich hand-painted realistic strategy-game UI art, sculpted volume, tactile stone and engraved metal, restrained violet light from the crystals, neutral highlights. IMPORTANT composition: the top rail occupies only the top 18 percent of the image; the left rail occupies only the left 18 percent. Ornament at their junction may occupy the top-left 35 percent square. The entire lower-right 65 percent square must be completely flat green and EMPTY for interface content. Each rail narrows steadily toward the right edge and the bottom edge and ends in a slim brass finial point within the canvas, leaving a small green margin, so this can sit over continuous rails. No right or bottom border. Do not use green, teal or lime anywhere in the fitting itself. No scenery, no text, no letters, no numerals, no creatures, no frame around the entire image, no shadow on the background. All crystals fully inside the canvas. This is a practical small detailed corner asset, not an illustration of a room.
